name: Variable Interest 1 Rate
definition: Provides the index used to define the rate and optionaly the basis point spread.

Index.name: Index
Index.definition: Specifies the index taken into account to calculate the variable interest rate.

BasisPointSpread.name: Basis Point Spread
BasisPointSpread.definition: Used to express differences in interest rates, for example, a difference of 0.10% is equivalent to a change of 10 basis points.
